about_the_game:
About This Game

(This product is still under development. Current version: 0.1001)

Currently available content includes:

  • Basic Knowledge Galaxy → Chinese Fundamentals Nebula → Mandatory Chinese Knowledge Planet → Chinese Required Poetry & Prose Memory Continent → Elementary School Required Poetry & Prose Memory Province

  • Basic Knowledge Galaxy → Foreign Language Fundamentals Galaxy → English Fundamentals Planet → English Vocabulary Memory Continent → High School English Vocabulary Memory Province

  • Grand Master Nebula → Ge Wu Zhi Zhi (Investigation of Things) System → Daoist Texts Planet → Voyage Continent

A total of three playable levels are open.

Knowledge Stellification:

Classics, poetry and other knowledge are restructured into a dynamic cosmic structure - from the "Grand Master Galaxy" to the "Inquiry into Things and Acquisition of Knowledge Star System", delving deeper layer by layer for exploration. Each planet represents an independent knowledge module (such as a chapter of "The Art of War by Sun Tzu"), and spatial coordinates are used for positioning to enhance memory.

Immersive Learning Engine:

• Free Exploration: WASD movement + mouse for perspective control, wander among knowledge planets

Knowledge Blackboard: Displays original text, pinyin, and annotation explanations (as shown in the following figure)

• Data-driven: Smart tables dynamically manage massive amounts of text to ensure precise content updates (as shown in the following figure).

Cognitive training system:

Based on spatial memory algorithms, it associates abstract knowledge with three-dimensional coordinates to enhance memory efficiency.

Future Vision:

We will build a "knowledge universe" - in the future, users will be able to customize knowledge planets, share learning maps, and eventually form a decentralized cognitive network. Join this cognitive revolution and make learning a journey across the stars!

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: win7/win10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6400 or AMD FX 8320
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 6GB
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system

short_description: Explore a 3D Knowledge Cosmos! Memory Universe: Spatial memory training software. Visualize classics like Art of War as interactive galaxies. WASD/mouse navigation. Cross-platform learning adventure. Become a knowledge "Grandmaster"!
